capabilities: Import external files as linked or embedded attachments via commands, drag-and-drop, or paste
Configure attachment folder locations, naming conventions, and date formats
Move attachments to the folder of the note that uses them when text is split, merged, or pasted
Relocate stray attachments with per-file confirmation
Rename, delete, or auto-remove empty attachment folders and toggle their visibility in the file explorer
extras: Links update automatically when attachments move; files outside managed attachment folders are left untouched.
intentEvidence: designed to enhance the attachment management experience in Obsidian
problem: Obsidian's default attachment handling is limited: imports can't be embedded or linked flexibly, folders accumulate stray files, and attachments stay behind when text is moved to another note.
summary: Attachment manager that imports external files into the vault as links or embeds and keeps attachments organized in per-note folders.
